mapper.select: SELECT graph::text FROM experiment_graph WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2}

SELECT h.id AS "id", h.experiment_id AS "experimentId", e.experiment_no AS "experimentNo", h.from_workcell_id AS "fromWorkcellId", rf.name AS "fromName", h.to_workcell_id AS "toWorkcellId", rt.name AS "toName", h.status AS "status", h.carrier AS "carrier", h.remark AS "remark" FROM experiment_handoff h JOIN experiment e ON e.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND e.id = h.experiment_id LEFT JOIN resource_node rf ON rf.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND rf.id = h.from_workcell_id LEFT JOIN resource_node rt ON rt.tenant_id = h.tenant_id AND rt.id = h.to_workcell_id WHERE h.tenant_id = #{param1} AND h.status = #{param2} ORDER BY h.id DESC LIMIT #{param3}

SELECT from_workcell_id AS "fromWorkcellId", to_workcell_id AS "toWorkcellId", carrier AS "carrier", status AS "status", remark AS "remark" FROM experiment_handoff WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY from_workcell_id, to_workcell_id

SELECT ew.workcell_id AS "workcellId", rn.name AS "name" FROM experiment_workcell ew LEFT JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.tenant_id = ew.tenant_id AND rn.id = ew.workcell_id WHERE ew.tenant_id = #{param1} AND ew.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY ew.workcell_id

SELECT p.seq AS "seq", p.workflow_id AS "workflowId", p.loop_count AS "loopCount", w.name AS "name" FROM experiment_process p LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.id = p.workflow_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.seq
SELECT seq AS "seq", loop_index AS "loopIndex", status AS "status", run_id AS "runId", error AS "error" FROM experiment_run_step WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_run_id = #{param2}
SELECT experiment_id AS "experimentId", status AS "status", expanded_steps AS "expandedSteps" FROM experiment_run WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND id = #{param2}

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.status AS "status", r.control_state AS "controlState", r.expanded_steps AS "expandedSteps", r.current_seq AS "currentSeq", r.started_at AS "startedAt", r.finished_at AS "finishedAt", r.error AS "error", r.pause_kind AS "pauseKind", r.pause_reason AS "pauseReason", r.stop_requested AS "stopRequested", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "durationSec" FROM experiment_run r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} AND r.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 20

SELECT r.id AS "id", r.experiment_id AS "experimentId", e.name AS "experimentName", e.experiment_no AS "experimentNo", e.island_id AS "islandId", r.status AS "status", r.control_state AS "controlState", r.expanded_steps AS "expandedSteps", r.current_seq AS "currentSeq", r.started_at AS "startedAt", r.finished_at AS "finishedAt", r.error AS "error", r.pause_kind AS "pauseKind", r.pause_reason AS "pauseReason", r.stop_requested AS "stopRequested", EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (r.finished_at - r.started_at)) AS "durationSec" FROM experiment_run r JOIN experiment e ON e.id = r.experiment_id WHERE r.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY r.id DESC LIMIT 200

SELECT id AS "id", name AS "name", type AS "type", default_value AS "defaultValue", description AS "description" FROM experiment_variable WHERE tenant_id = #{param1} AND experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY id

SELECT DISTINCT ON (v.name) v.name AS "name", v.type AS "type", v.default_value AS "defaultValue", v.description AS "description", v.workflow_id AS "workflowId", w.name AS "workflowName" FROM workflow_variable v JOIN workflow w ON w.id = v.workflow_id JOIN experiment_process p ON p.workflow_id = v.workflow_id WHERE v.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY v.name, p.seq

SELECT p.id AS "id", p.workflow_id AS "workflowId", p.seq AS "seq", p.run_mode AS "runMode", p.run_after AS "runAfter", p.loop_count AS "loopCount", w.name AS "workflowName", w.code AS "workflowCode", (SELECT count(*) FROM workflow_node n WHERE n.workflow_id = p.workflow_id AND n.node_type = 'task') AS "nodeCount" FROM experiment_process p JOIN workflow w ON w.id = p.workflow_id WHERE p.tenant_id = #{param1} AND p.experiment_id = #{param2} ORDER BY p.seq

SELECT e.id AS "id", e.experiment_no AS "experimentNo", e.name AS "name", e.status AS "status", e.version AS "version", e.priority AS "priority", e.planned_at AS "plannedAt", e.started_at AS "startedAt", e.finished_at AS "finishedAt", e.remark AS "remark", e.workflow_id AS "workflowId", w.name AS "workflowName", isl.code AS "islandCode", isl.name AS "islandName", (SELECT string_agg(rn.name, '、' ORDER BY rn.name) FROM experiment_workcell ew JOIN resource_node rn ON rn.id = ew.workcell_id WHERE ew.tenant_id = e.tenant_id AND ew.experiment_id = e.id) AS "workcellNames", (SELECT count(*) FROM experiment_process p WHERE p.experiment_id = e.id) AS "flowCount" FROM experiment e LEFT JOIN workflow w ON w.id = e.workflow_id LEFT JOIN resource_node isl ON isl.id = e.island_id WHERE e.tenant_id = #{param1} ORDER BY e.id DESC LIMIT #{param2}
